text:
anya: quick heads-up — int4-canary on longdoc-retrieval showing weird quality variance vs baseline on a small slice.
matt: specifics?
anya: sample metric: concordance MRR dropped 0.027 on slice 'kb-long' (n=3.2k), but overall aggregate delta is -0.004. p95 latency +20ms, p99 +120ms.
liam: p99 spike matters — is that KV cache warmup?
anya: KV looks warm. heatmap shows traffic concentrated on queries with >4k tokens.
devex: can you paste the smoke eval snippet you ran?
anya: pasted below:
```
curl -X POST https://canary-api/ev --data '{
 "model":"rwd-v2-int4",
 "eval":"longdoc_mrr_cohort",
 "samples":3200
}'
```
sophia-bot: alert: canary(metrics) posted to /canary-dash at 1754009900
matt: yikes p99 +120ms + MRR drop 0.027. proposal: new sentinel metric that composite-scores latency tail and quality delta so we avoid false positives.
liam: define sentinel?
matt: sentinel = max(0, delta_mrr_normed) + alpha * latency_p99_normed where normed scaled to [0,1] by historical spread. alpha=0.4 initial.
anya: for auto-fallback we'd set threshold 0.03 for sentinel and require window 15m over 5% of traffic.
devex: prefer conservative: 0.035 and require both sentinel>threshold and p99_backoff>80ms for >=10m.
liam: agree. also do shadow for 4h with stratified long-doc slice to confirm.
anya: running shadow now, command:
```
rb run-shadow --model rwd-v2-int4 --duration 4h --slices longdoc,kb-long
```
matt: add an eval hook: if hallucination-rate delta > 0.01 trigger manual review.
anya: logged in dashboard: https://dash/canary/1754009876
sophia-bot: canary-rollout configured: auto-fallback:disabled (manual until shadow completes)
jordan: quick question — if sentinel edges over threshold for <5m do we throttled traffic or immediate rollback?
matt: plan: soft-cut (50% of canary traffic) for transient blips under 10m, immediate rollback if over window.
liam: document config snippet for ops:
```
canary:
  sentinel_threshold: 0.035
  latency_p99_ms_threshold: 80
  window_minutes: 10
  transient_action: scale-down-traffic:0.5
  persistent_action: immediate-rollback
  require: ["sentinel","p99_latency"]
```
devex: I'll add to runbook and notify SRE.
anya: current shadow run shows MRR delta -0.012 and p99 +40ms after 25m — not crossing threshold yet.
matt: keep watching for 3h. I want nightly batch eval too.
liam: thumbs up. also let's capture per-cohort confusion matrix for the longdoc slice.
anya: noted. i'll post a short postmortem if we rollback.
matt: thanks all. :thumbsup:
